focus: correctness: hub routing tables (mode-registry, hub-router, leaf manifests, SKILL/ROUTER clauses) against compiled front-door behaviour

findingDetails.title: Reject outcome documented as reachable from the compiled front door, but the CLI cannot pass the constraint that produces it
findingDetails.scopeProof: SKILL.md and ROUTER.md and all four router files are listed in review-scope-files.txt for this lineage

claimAdjudication.claim: SKILL.md:62 documents a reject outcome reachable from the compiled-route CLI, but the CLI cannot pass constraints.
claimAdjudication.counterevidenceSought: Read every CLI flag in compiled-route.cjs and grepped the promoted runtime engine for constraints plumbing; constraints exist only in the library API.
claimAdjudication.alternativeExplanation: A library consumer can pass constraints directly, so the outcome is live in the library and only undocumented from the CLI.
claimAdjudication.downgradeTrigger: Stays P2 while no shipped hub caller relies on the four-arm contract; would rise to P1 only if a caller trusted it and dropped a refusal.

results.summary: Hub routing claims match compiled behaviour for route, orderedBundle and defer; the reject arm has no CLI producer.

noveltyJustification: First iteration of the run: every finding is new, so weighted new equals weighted total. The single P2 is a newly observed doc/CLI mismatch, not a restatement of prior work.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: Pre-bound scope is 522 files across a skill tree, a compiled-routing library, an advisor runtime and 15 spec phases.

targetSelection.selectionReason: The correctness dimension for a routing hub is decided by its routing tables and the runtime front door that serves them.

searchLedger.invariant: Every alias in mode-registry.json must be scoreable by a hub-router.json vocabulary class, and every non-discovery class must be referenced by exactly one mode signal.

searchActions.result: all 20 aliases present; 6 classes referenced, 2 discovery-only classes unreferenced by design

searchLedger.rationale: Alias and class sets are bidirectionally aligned.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Every alias resolves to a class and no class is orphaned.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The compiled policy may lag hub-router.json 1.1.3.0 and serve older vocabulary.

searchActions.queryOrPath: compiled-route.cjs --hub mcp-browser-use on 1.1.3.0-era and negative prompts
searchActions.result: ten probes returned the authored decision incl. defer for bare aside; effectivePolicyHash fc55eafa generation 1

searchLedger.rationale: Replay of the authored vocabulary produced the authored decisions.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: No drift between authored vocabulary and served policy.

searchLedger.claim: SKILL.md:62 and ROUTER.md:107 promise a reject decision from the documented CLI, which accepts no constraints.

searchActions.result: router emits reject only for constraints.has(forbidden); CLI exposes no constraint flag

searchLedger.rationale: The documented four-arm contract has a dead arm in the documented workflow.

searchLedger.invariant: Every RESOURCE_MAP path must be listed in the generated leaf-manifest.json for its packet.

searchActions.result: all eight stage-two paths present for their packets

searchLedger.rationale: No routed leaf is missing from the generated manifest.

searchLedger.invariant: Every tool name in the hub capability matrix must exist in the packet leaf that owns it.

searchActions.queryOrPath: lighthouse_audit, performance_start_trace, bdg console --list, bdg network har
searchActions.result: all named tools appear in the owning packet docs

searchLedger.rationale: Capability matrix names match the packet catalog.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Verified by direct read of the owning leaf.
